noah: Hey team — opening my first PR, small change in runtime/config: add env var for KV cache TTL. Quick questions: preferred commit message style, reviewers, tests to run?

Priya: Congrats! use Conventional Commits. Example: `chore(runtime): add KV_CACHE_TTL env var` if non-user-facing; if feature, `feat(runtime): ...`. Put description in the body and reference any related issue.

jen: Reviewers: add @eng-runtime and one @eng-platform if it's config-ops. If touching infra, also ping owen. Runtime core changes need 2 approvers, one must be a runtime owner.

ci-bot: Please ensure all checks pass: lint, mypy, unit, integration. Run `./dev/setup && pre-commit run --all-files`. CI will block merge on failures.

noah: I ran unit tests locally but I'm seeing a ruff lint error on formatting. Should I fix and force-push or add a fixup commit?

Priya: Fix and force-push after rebase on main. We like clean history but we squash on merge so small fixups are fine. If the fix is noisy, do an interactive rebase to tidy.

owen: Branch naming: use `chore/noah/kv-cache-ttl` or `feat/noah/kv-cache-ttl` depending on the change. Also add a one-line changelog note if behavior changes.

noah: Sample commit I'll use: `chore(runtime): expose KV_CACHE_TTL env var` with a body explaining default and rationale. OK?

jen: Yep. If you added any new config keys, add them to `docs/configuration.md` and include a migration note. Also tag integration tests with `[integration]` if relevant.

noah: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/512 — pinging @eng-runtime and @owen for review. CI failing on mypy: Optional[str] mismatch in runtime/config.py:88. Anyone seen this before?

owen: Likely needs typing fix or explicit cast. Push a small commit to change the annotation or guard the assignment. Rebase if main moved.

ci-bot: mypy error in src/runtime/config.py:88: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "Optional[str]", variable has type "str").

noah: Thanks — fixing now. Will push the change and request review. :sparkles:
